preconditions.description: Length of the string s is between 1 and 10^5.
Number of kinds of pairs of brackets k is between 1 and n.
Length of the string s matches the given n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= abs(t) <= k for t in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in s is an integer between 1 and k in absolute value.
Number of queries q is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all((query[0] == 1 and 1 <= query[1] <= n and 1 <= abs(query[2]) <= k) or (query[0] == 2 and 1 <= query[1] <= query[2] <= n) for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query is either of type 1 with valid indices and bracket type, or of type 2 with valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == 'Yes' if is_correct_bracket_sequence(s[queries[i][1]-1:queries[i][2]]) else 'No' for i in range(len(queries)) if queries[i][0] == 2)
postconditions.description: For each query of type 2, output 'Yes' if the substring is a correct bracket sequence, otherwise 'No'.
